description: §42.4: `!a` on `string | not` is E-OPERATOR-OPERAND-TYPE (write `a is not`).
rationale: §42.4 statement 7: "As an operand of `!`, `&&` or `||` … a `T | not` value is not a boolean and SHALL be compile error `E-OPERATOR-OPERAND-TYPE`". Provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S460 "a′, go" (supersedes S440 Truthiness Q2 for conditions; keeps S440 #4 = (c), Q1, Gotcha Q2, S442).
